entities.summary: Joseph Benjamin Pignatano was an American professional baseball player and coach. As a catcher, Pignatano played in Major League Baseball (MLB) during all or part of six seasons (1957–1962) for the Brooklyn / Los Angeles Dodgers (1957–1960), Kansas City Athletics (1961), San Francisco Giants (1962), and New York Mets (1962). After his playing career, he was a coach for the Mets, Washington Senators, and Atlanta Braves.
